sigiriya.name: Sigiriya Ancient Citadel
sigiriya.tagline: The 5th-century fortress in the sky surrounded by landscaped royal gardens.
sigiriya.description: Rising 200 meters above the central plains, the ancient rock fortress of Sigiriya stands as an astonishing feat of ancient urban planning, architecture, and hydraulic engineering. Ascend through the massive Lion's Paws to marvel at world-renowned 5th-century frescoes and panoramic jungle vistas.
highlights: Remarkable ancient mirror wall and fresco gallery
Symmetrical water gardens with working fountains
Breathtaking 360-degree views of the cultural triangle

ella.name: Ella & Highlands
ella.tagline: Emerald tea terraces, dramatic mist-clad peaks, and colonial railway architecture.
ella.description: Nestled in the central highlands, Ella is a tranquil mountain village enveloped by cool cloud forests and verdant tea estates. Marvel at the colonial Nine Arches Viaduct as the blue train passes through lush rainforest, and trek to Little Adam's Peak for sunrise over Ella Gap.
highlights: Iconic Nine Arches Demodara colonial viaduct
Scenic hike up Little Adam's Peak and Ella Rock
Ceylon tea tasting in historic high-elevation estates
Cascading Ravana waterfall and natural pools

galle.name: Galle Fort
galle.tagline: A living 17th-century Dutch colonial bastion overlooking the Indian Ocean.
galle.description: Wander through centuries-old cobblestone lanes flanked by Dutch colonial villas, artisan jewelry workshops, and historic churches. The UNESCO-listed Galle Fort combines maritime heritage with vibrant coastal café culture, protected by dramatic granite ramparts facing ocean sunsets.
highlights: Iconic white lighthouse overlooking turquoise waters
Boutique artisan shops, gem houses, and spice merchants
Sunset walks along the Indian Ocean sea wall

mirissa.name: Mirissa Coast
mirissa.tagline: Golden crescent shores, gentle surf breaks, and world-class blue whale watching.
mirissa.description: Mirissa is the crown jewel of Sri Lanka's southern coastline, renowned for tranquil coconut-fringed bays, fresh seafood by the shoreline, and thrilling ocean expeditions. Embark at dawn onto the continental shelf to witness the majestic blue whale, the largest creature on earth.
highlights: Ethical blue whale and dolphin watching cruises
Iconic Coconut Tree Hill promontory viewpoint
Gentle beach surf breaks and coral reef snorkeling
Candlelit oceanfront dining featuring fresh Ceylon catch
